findings.issue: No test infrastructure whatsoever: no test script, no runner (vitest/node:test) despite devDependencies already including vite/typescript
findings.suggestion: Add node:test (zero extra deps for pure modules) or vitest, and wire a 'test' script into the build

findings.issue: Filtering, matching-count text and pagination slicing are untested; a slice off-by-one or a wrong conjunction operand would shift every list page
findings.suggestion: Extract filterMatches/species data assembly into a pure function and test empty query, single filters, combined filters, page clamping, and the 'No Pokémon found' path

findings.issue: speciesCards encodes the spec's subtlest rule (exclude IDs >10000, dedup, map pokemon refs to species names like deoxys-normal→Deoxys); untested
findings.suggestion: Unit test with fixtures containing alternate forms, duplicates and a pokemon whose name differs from its species name

findings.issue: Bidirectional nulls-last sorting, direction toggling and aria-sort updates are untested; each is a classic flip/off-by-one regression
findings.suggestion: Table-driven tests: sort asc/desc on a column with missing values, click twice, assert order and aria-sort attributes

findings.issue: Localization rules (findLast vs find, collapseWhitespace, humanize, dexNumber padding) are pure and trivially testable but have no assertions
findings.suggestion: Direct unit tests for humanize, dexNumber, latestFlavorText ordering and englishName fallback

findings.issue: Moves grouping, dedup by (url, level), method ordering and level-then-name sorting are untested
findings.suggestion: Extract grouping into a pure function taking pokemon.moves and a version group; test mixed methods, duplicate entries and missing power/accuracy

findings.issue: Promise cache (dedup + failed-request eviction) and NotFoundError mapping are untested
findings.suggestion: Test with a stubbed fetch: 404 throws NotFoundError, failed requests are evicted so a retry re-fetches, same URL reuses the in-flight promise

findings.issue: Debounce timer is never cancelled when the page is left, so updateUrl can push a stale query after navigation (and triggers a render of a dead view)
findings.suggestion: Cancel the timer in the page teardown/mounted lifecycle and add a test that navigates away mid-debounce then asserts location/history length

findings.issue: Navigation race guard and popstate/hash handling are untested; a broken token check would render stale pages under slow API responses
findings.suggestion: An integration-style test rendering two routes back-to-back with a delayed first response would catch a removed guard

summary: The app contains no tests of its own — no runner, no script, no test files — so every risky behaviour (filtering, pagination, species mapping, sorting, URL state, caching, localization) is guarded only by the acceptance suite the team will eventually stop running per-change. Most of this logic is pure and could be tested with node:test at zero dependency cost. Until tests exist, any refactor of api.ts, format.ts, table.ts or home.ts is a blind landing.
